method: 读出候选断言的源码断言体，判断其实际断言的行为是否覆盖条款语义。
被引断言必须在该基线的执行收据中明确出现且为通过（本批次内，或本批为此单独执行的覆盖文件收据 covering-batches*.json）。
本文件只记录判读结论，不改矩阵 tests 指针，不提升任何行状态。

judgments.coveringAssertion: P2C-2A Run queued -> starting emits run.dequeued with service timestamp

supportingAssertions.name: P2C-2A Run starting -> failed persists failure fields and emits run.failed
P2C-2A Run running -> paused emits run.paused

judgments.rationale: 断言体：transitionRun(queued→starting) 后断言 Run 状态为 starting 且事件类型恰为 'run.dequeued'、payload 带 dequeuedAt；starting→failed 断言事件 'run.failed' 且带 errorCode/message/phase/retryable。逐转移的「状态迁移 → 事件类型与载荷」映射被直接断言。

judgments.clause: retry creates a new Run with preserved lineage;
judgments.coveringAssertion: P3C1-RY-S02 Retry persists the exact fingerprint, Child fields, Events, and Outbox atomically

supportingAssertions.name: [M27-P4-T005] Bridge retry and failure stay isolated from P3 compatibility rows and Registry evidence

judgments.rationale: 断言体：retry 后断言 retry.run.reason==='retry' 且 retry.run.parentRunId===first.run.id；P3C1-RY-S02 进一步断言 child.parentRunId===parent.id 并连同 fingerprint/子字段/事件/Outbox 原子持久化。既证明是新 Run，也证明谱系被保留。
judgments.receipt: covering-batches.json（本批单独执行本文件，92 passed / 0 fail，exit 0）

judgments.clause: Task creation is idempotent and separate from Run creation;
judgments.coveringAssertion: CR4B-02 create-task is idempotent across retries and starts nothing
judgments.rationale: 断言体：同一输入三次 createTaskFromMessage → created 分别 true/false/false，第二三次返回同一 task.id，库中 tasks 行数为 1、**runs 行数为 0**。两句条款各有直接断言：幂等（重复调用收敛到同一 Task）与「与建 Run 分离」（建 Task 不产生 Run）。
judgments.receipt: covering-batches-2.json（本批单独执行本文件，14 passed / 0 fail，exit 0）

judgments.clause: Worktree absence does not block a modifying Run after Workspace admission;
judgments.candidateAssertion: reconciles missing paths as failed without deleting worktrees
judgments.rationale: 断言体覆盖 WorktreeManager 对缺失路径的**协调与失败标记**，与「无 Worktree 时被准入的 modifying Run 仍可继续」不是同一命题。全仓检索未见断言「worktree 缺失 + 已准入 → Run 照常执行」的断言。按缺口记录。
